Thanks again for the call this morning, Lisa — useful conversation and great to hear about Priime's immediate priorities around latency and data isolation. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goal for next session: 60-minute hands-on walkthrough (demo + ops Q&A) focused on production inference, cost controls, and deployment options (hosted vs. private).
- Proposed length: 60 minutes (45 demo / 15 ops + sizing).
- Attendee ask from your side: engineering lead + security/ops contact if possible.
- From our side: I will lead the product walkthrough and Marcus (solutions engineer) will cover architecture and sizing.

Can you confirm two 60-minute windows that work for your team next week (we suggested Tue/Wed/Thu mornings PT), and who from Priime will join (names + roles) so we can tailor the agenda? Once you confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and the agenda attached.

Thanks — Avery
